objections: geo_city is a required field for impossible-travel detection (CYBER-U1); the single rare city (one row) is most likely the out-of-pattern sign-in the rule must flag, so merging it into 'other' hides exactly the anomaly.
The merge adds no protection: geo_lat/geo_lon are kept at city level and reveal the same rare city, and geo_country is kept unmerged; the column set is inconsistent.
Nine coarse city values under a DPA with keyed user pseudonyms carry low risk; keep is the right trade-off.
